user_query: I want to create a sports website that covers transfer news, latest transfers, and player market value.

TaskList.description: Access the transfer records API to retrieve information about player transfers, including player details and trade values.
Parse the retrieved transfer records to display the latest transfers on the website.
Access the player market value API function to get up-to-date market values for players.
Retrieve game plans and short information about upcoming competitions using the relevant API.
Compile all the retrieved data (transfers, market values, and competition plans) to update the sports website.
